Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice, whereas inadvertently forgetting to turn off the stove reflects negligence rather than an intentional or reckless burning.

Q9000.reason: UN General Assembly resolutions are not independently binding but may enunciate or provide evidence of customary international law.

Q9002.reason: The grantor’s reserved power to re-enter upon breach creates a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent, not an automatically terminating estate.
